Generation itself has final authorization-before-IO ordering; don't reintroduce stale authorization in callback.

Callback used inside lock must not recursively read this store/guard or block indefinitely. Do not claim DB/grant cross-system atomicity; explicit logical acceptance point. Exact source/provenance/pinned config and validation_version to outbox.

Catch StoreBusy/ClockError/Conflict within brief domain; active stale attempt cannot write draft/cause as owner, maintenance path only when properly bounded/CAS. Unknown external outcomes conservative, never report ready on failed commit; if commit response lost reconcile scoped durable outbox without retransmitting model call.
